behavior: Personal-data exports now include own_music_queue_items. Only persisted entries whose requested_by_user_id matches the requesting account are emitted. Queue item identity and position preserve repeated tracks. Track fields are explicitly allowlisted; raw shared queue JSON, other requester entries and unknown future fields are excluded.

own_music_operations contains only receipts owned by actor_id with channel_id, request_id, session_id, expected_revision and created_at. Raw result_json and request_hash are excluded; this is operation receipt metadata, not a reconstructed action or full playback history.
Existing ciphertext, encryption version, sender device and opaque metadata exports remain unchanged; the server does not decrypt messages.

Large snapshot collection remains outside the global retirement lock. Final export publication shares the existing account-retirement boundary (PostgreSQL advisory lock and SQLite writer boundary), checks live human/non-disabled/non-banned state and captured token version, then inserts and returns job metadata in one transaction. PostgreSQL locks the account row after the retirement boundary.

Get and Download query current live/non-disabled/non-banned human owner state along with owner, export ID and expiry. Unauthorized publication returns Unauthorized; hidden/missing/expired downloads return NotFound.

Human self-deletion and bot retirement explicitly delete data_exports for the retiring identity within anonymization cleanup, including when foreign-key enforcement is disabled. Other accounts exports and shared ciphertext/history remain.

focused_native.note: Includes ownership/expiry/secret exclusion, notification decisions, duplicate own music entries, unknown/foreign field exclusion, ciphertext preservation, disabled/deleted/stale-token guards, deterministic collected-snapshot-before-deletion race, shared-history cleanup with FK-on and FK-off.

focused_postgres.fixture: Random password existed only in process environment; uniquely named owned container exposed on loopback with dynamically allocated port. Existing newTestDB used isolated schemas/native PostgreSQL migrations. Container removed and environment restored; no credential values printed or saved.

verification.deterministic_race: Test-only TxQuerier wrapper pauses RawDB unwrapping after all snapshot rows close and before final publication. Real anonymization commits first; resumed export is Unauthorized, no export row survives or is recreated, and the prior snapshot cannot be downloaded. Runs against both databases without production test hooks.

broad_native_repository.note: Whole repository package passed on native SQLite at this source freeze. No whole-server, remote CI or production claim.

static.format: gofmt applied to owned Go files
static.diff: git diff --check passed for owned files

limits: No individual-session ID is part of the unchanged repository interface. Per-session-only revocation after middleware admission is not independently revalidated here; the patch closes the account retirement/live-state/token-version publication boundary.
Get/Download guards evaluate at database read time; already returned or transmitted bytes cannot be revoked. No claim of cancellation of an already admitted download stream.
Only currently persisted music queue entries and stored receipt metadata are exported. No complete historical music audit log is invented.
No production, Windows, browser or multi-client runtime acceptance was performed. No complete P2 acceptance or deployment is claimed.
No schema change, commit or push was performed by this subagent. Root owns final evidence integration, static false-positive exact-hash review and publication.
